# Burnell Consultancy Ltd

> UK platform security engineering consultancy. We take credentials out of code,
> make machine images compliant by default, and turn scanner noise into a
> roadmap engineers will follow.

## Entity
- Legal name: Burnell Consultancy Ltd
- Founder: Dr David Burnell, PhD (Durham University, Biological Chemistry)
- Registered: England and Wales, company number [placeholder]

## What we do (vendor-neutral: Vault, OpenBao, cloud KMS, CyberArk)
- Secrets and Pipeline Security Assessment: £14,000 fixed, two weeks, one business unit. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/assessment/
- Secrets and vault engineering: typically £45,000 to £120,000. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/services/secrets-vault/
- Golden image factory (CIS-compliant images): £28,000 to £60,000 fixed. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/services/golden-images/
- Security maturity (OWASP SAMM + ASPM): scoped. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/services/security-maturity/
- PKI and machine identity: typically £45,000 to £120,000. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/services/pki/

## Who we help
- Series B+ fintech and SaaS facing enterprise due diligence. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/who-we-help/scaling-saas/
- Regulated gaming, gambling and payments platforms. https://burnellconsultancy.co.uk/who-we-help/regulated-platforms/

## Disambiguating founder bio
Dr David Burnell is a UK platform security engineer who architected secrets management
at more than 1,000 Vault namespaces and moved CIS Level 1 compliance from 25% to
over 95% in a single programme. He holds a PhD from Durham University and
previously worked at IBM Security, HP, G-Research and Aristocrat.

## Proof, not marketing
No fabricated testimonials, client logos or certifications. Trust rests on the
PhD, the publications, the employer track record and public fixed prices.
